description.text:
`SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma` is a chat model fine-tuned to **roleplay a therapist** in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations. It is part of the **SQPsychLLM** family released with the paper *Roleplaying with Structure: Synthetic Therapist-Client Conversation Generation from Questionnaires*.

This checkpoint is **Llama-3-8B-Instruct** supervised-fine-tuned on **SQPsychConv (Gemma)**, the synthetic corpus generated by `google/gemma-3-27b-it` from real, de-identified structured client profiles and psychological questionnaires (BDI, HAM-D).

warning.quote: This model must **not** be used to: provide therapy, diagnosis, or any clinical decision to real people;

serving.text_only_input_quote: {"role": "user", "content": "I've felt down and unmotivated for weeks and I don't know why."}
serving.system_prompt: You are an empathetic therapist conducting a CBT-informed session.
serving.notes: The file list has no tokenizer files. tokenizer_config.json returns 404. There is no adapter_config.json. The stored weights are float32. The card example loads dtype bfloat16, temperature 0.7, and max_new_tokens 512. generation_config.json uses temperature 0.6 and max_length 4096. The system string is in the card's usage example.

evaluation_reported.text: Table 3, questionnaire-conditioned row for SQPsychLLM gemma: CounselingBench zero-shot R 0.49 F1 0.48; zero-shot CoT R 0.58 S 0.58; CBT-CD R 0.55 F1 0.35; CBT-PC R 0.80 F1 0.71; CBT-FC R 0.58 F1 0.35. The paper defines SQPsychLLM gemma as Llama3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on the gemma corpus. It does not print AIMH/SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma.

discrepancies: The inventory matches the card on sft, AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma, and meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct. The card also says the instruction-formatted split used for training is AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma_finetune. The paper says learning rate 2e-4 for SQPsychLLM. src/finetune.py sets learning_rate=2e-5 for the same Llama-3-8B-Instruct base. The paper does not print this repository id; it writes SQPsychLLM gemma. The project page and the GitHub README print AIMH/SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma.
